entities.summary: Ivan Grigorovich-Barsky or Ivan Hryhorovych-Barskyi was a Ukrainian-born Imperial Russian architect who worked in the Late Cossack Baroque style. He was a graduate of the Kyiv-Mohyla Academy, and designed many buildings and churches in Kyiv and elsewhere.
